description:
A Wind Energy Operations Manager needs to validate the performance of a 1.5MW turbine following a gearbox maintenance event. You have access to high-frequency SCADA logs in 'turbine_scada.csv'.

Your goal is to build a Power BI report named 'Turbine_Performance.pbix' on the Desktop that constructs an IEC 61400-12 Power Curve. The report must:
1. Import 'turbine_scada.csv' from 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\PowerBITasks\'.
2. Filter the data to include ONLY records where 'Status_Code' is 'OK'.
3. Create a Calculated Column named 'Wind_Bin' that rounds 'Wind_Speed_ms' down to the nearest integer (e.g., using FLOOR or INT).
4. Create a DAX Measure named 'Avg_Power' that calculates the average of 'Power_kW'.
5. Create a Line Chart showing 'Avg_Power' (Y-axis) by 'Wind_Bin' (X-axis).
6. Create a Scatter Chart showing raw 'Power_kW' (Y-axis) by 'Wind_Speed_ms' (X-axis) to visualize variance.
7. Save the report as 'Turbine_Performance.pbix' to the Desktop.
